_doc: Three-turn conversations for the pathway_eval personas (run_personalized_search_harness --case-set conversations). Turn 1 is the persona's opening message, built from its intake as for --case-set personas. Turns 2 and 3 are scripted in the persona's voice and reveal its constraints, so every arm gets the same information at the same turn (the fixed style). In the adaptive style, turns 2 and 3 instead send the follow-up chip with the most keyword hits, and fall back to the scripted message when no chip matches. goal is what a relevant page serves, for reviewers.

conversations.goal: Move from insurance into financial advising; wants a recognized finance credential.
turns: I'd like a certificate path I can do self-paced around my job.
Focus on financial planning and investments, not insurance.

conversations.goal: Biochemistry undergrad aiming for biomedical engineering work in pharma.
turns: I still have two years of school, so something I can do alongside classes.
Show me programs pharma employers would value, like biomedical devices or drug manufacturing.

conversations.goal: Stay in student success and apply AI at work: applied, practical AI, not a career change or theory.
turns: I don't want to change careers. I want to stay in student success and just use AI better at work.
Practical and quick, please: things like chatbots and prompt writing, not theory.

conversations.goal: Medical assistant working toward nurse practitioner: clinical and health knowledge (no NP degree in the catalog).
turns: I know I'll need a nursing degree eventually. For now I want courses that build clinical knowledge.
Something on pharmacology, patient assessment or public health would help.

conversations.goal: Developer and certified Scrum Master moving into product management at their company.
turns: I've done Scrum already, so skip agile basics. I need product strategy and roadmapping.
A certificate would help me make the case to my manager.

conversations.goal: Data analyst who wants to get better with everyday tools (SQL, analytics, maybe Python) for a promotion or resume.
turns: Mostly I want to get better at SQL and the analytics tools I use every day, and maybe learn Python too!
Intermediate is right, I already know mySQL pretty well. Self-paced is best for me.

conversations.goal: Machine learning engineer required to take a course: short, advanced ML content.
turns: ML engineer. Need something short.
Advanced. MLOps or deep learning.

conversations.goal: Frustrated administrative assistant who wants a better-paying job; career and job-search skills.
turns: I don't know. Something that pays. Business stuff maybe?
fine, something to help me get hired fast: resume, interviews, that kind of thing

conversations.goal: Experienced AI engineer staying current on generative AI: advanced, recent material.
turns: Generative AI specifically: LLMs, agents, how companies are deploying them.
Advanced level, and short. I keep up with a lot already.

conversations.goal: Wants welding certification; the catalog has no welding content, so an honest caveat beats filler.
turns: I want welding certification prep, hands-on if possible.
If there's nothing on welding, what about blueprint reading or construction safety?
